subject: gk
question: Which of the following languages is NOT in the top 3 most spoken native languages of India (as of 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telugu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The top 3 most spoken native languages in India as of 2021 are **Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi**.
 
• Hindi is the most widely spoken language in India with a significant number of native speakers.
 
• Bengali is the second most spoken native language, primarily spoken in West Bengal and parts of Bangladesh.
 
• Marathi is the third most spoken native language, predominantly used in the state of Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindi:**

 
 
• Hindi, written in the Devanagari script, is one of the official languages of India and the most spoken language in the country.
 
• It is spoken by a large population in northern and central India.
 
• Hindi is part of the Indo-Aryan branch of the Indo-European language family.
 
 
 
• **Bengali:**
 
 
• Bengali, also known as Bangla, is the official language of Bangladesh and the Indian states of West Bengal, Tripura, and Assam.
 
• It is the second most spoken native language in India, with a rich literary heritage.
 
• Bengali is also part of the Indo-Aryan branch of the Indo-European language family.
 
 
 
• **Marathi:**
 
 
• Marathi is the official language of the state of Maharashtra in western India.
 
• It is the third most spoken native language in India.
 
• Marathi belongs to the Southern Indo-Aryan language family.
 
 
 
• **Telugu:**
 
 
• Telugu is a Dravidian language spoken primarily in the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
 
• It is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India but is not among the top 3 most spoken native languages in the country.
